mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMP ( EMP_ID, EMP_NAME, EMAIL, DEPT_CODE, JOB_CODE, SALARY, HIRE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{empId}, #{empName}, #{email}, #{deptId}, #{jobCode}, #{salary}, #{hireDate} )
mapper.select:
SELECT EMP_ID AS empId, EMP_NAME AS empName, EMAIL AS email, DEPT_CODE AS deptId, JOB_CODE AS jobCode, SALARY AS salary, HIRE_DATE AS hireDate FROM EMP
AND ( EMP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EMAIL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND DEPT_CODE = #{deptId}
AND ENT_YN = 'N'
ORDER BY EMP_NAME ASC
ORDER BY SALARY DESC
ORDER BY HIRE_DATE DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EMP
AND ( EMP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EMAIL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
